title: Shiseido takes Shein to court in EUR 2.6 million distribution dispute
summary: Shiseido is seeking more than EUR 2.6 million in damages from online retail giant Shein over the sale of its beauty products outside its authorized distribution network. The case could prove a landmark test of selective distribution agreements amid the rise of global e-commerce platforms. extraction.key_fact_quote: Beauté Prestige Internationale ( BPI ), a French subsidiary of Japanese cosmetics group Shiseido, has filed a lawsuit against online retail platform Shein, accusing it of selling its products outside its selective distribution network and in breach of the contractual conditions governing resale by authorised distributors.
